name: Mark Schoen-Cruz
bio: My name is Mark Schoen-Cruz. I'm a senior at Portsmouth High School and your 2026-2027 State Board Co-President! My FBLA journey, while uncertain at times, has been incredibly rewarding and has helped me grow as both a leader and a person. I look forward to building on the past state board's work while striving to serve RI FBLA's expanding community.
